# Equity note — RSU vesting

Restricted stock units (RSUs) vest over four years, typically with a one-year
cliff, and are taxed as ordinary income at vesting based on fair market value.

## Key points

- Vesting triggers a taxable event, not the grant date.
- Employers withhold taxes at vest, often via sell-to-cover.
- Basis for later capital gains is the value already taxed at vesting.
